text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain finally rises on the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Narita Brian faces off against 
the "Jet-Black Assassin," Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower looks frail at first glance, 
but she harbored a fierce will. Even when 
branded an "assassin" and treated like a 
villain, she never ran away from racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian pays respect to her strength, 
and challenges her with everything she 
has.
